calculation.description: Ranks each tradable benchmark against the same-day cross-sectional median of its three-session return; assets that have underperformed the peer median receive larger positive reversal scores. All inputs are lagged completed daily observations at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Daily one-session forward returns pass both benchmark gates. Regime IC/ICIR: 2020-22 0.012329/0.030777 (148 dates), 2023-24 0.016643/0.046521 (97 dates), 2025-26 0.1046086/0.2583979 (73 dates). Multi-day decay was not estimable under the strict synchronized-data construction because no dates retained >=8 complete observations for aggregated 5d/10d labels; treat the factor as a 1d signal and interpret uncertainty conservatively.
validation.audit_notes: Validation uses all 15 tradable assets, minimum 8 valid names/date; observation-only macro assets were not traded. Pairwise library correlation remains pending deterministic signal-artifact audit.
